desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE IS HERE! 🎃
👑 NEW: VOIDSEER PUMPKIN (0.056%)! Can you hatch it?

🦇 36 spooky Halloween pets and new Halloween eggs
🌕 Enter the HALLOWEEN DIMENSION through the orange portal
🐶 Help the Ghost Dog find his memories and fish with the Haunted Rod
👻 GHOULER the Ghost Boss haunts the Forest every 10 minutes: grab a Ghost Vacuum and suck him up for Souls
🕯️ GHOST HUNT every 10 minutes: catch spirits, collect Souls and trade them for a SPECTRAL mutation
🎁 Play time rewards: 67, Skeletal Sabertooth, Gorillastein, World Burner and AETHERON just for playing!
✨ Glowing pets: the Spectral and Neon parts now shine like they should

🐉 Ride your pets! Feed a ⭐ star to any pet and ride it around the map
🥚 Steal eggs from other players and defend your own base
🐣 Hatch them in your pen and collect pets from every biome
💰 Upgrade your base and treadmill to earn more cash

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for the next spooky update!
